title: The best man's speech
summary: Jorge has to give a speech at his brother's wedding, and he is terrified of public speaking.
paragraphs: When his older brother Álex asked him to be the {{best man}}, Jorge said yes immediately. He was proud and happy. It was only later, in the car on the way home, that he remembered: the best man gives a speech. In front of two hundred people. With a microphone. Jorge, who went red when he had to read aloud in class, felt sick.

He had three months to prepare. He wrote ten different speeches. The first was too long. The second was full of jokes that only he understood. The third was so serious that his girlfriend fell asleep while he was practising it. He searched online for advice and found a lot of it: start with a joke, tell a story, keep it short, don't drink too much before you speak.

The best advice came from his grandmother. "Don't try to be funny or clever," she said. "Just tell them one true thing about your brother that nobody else knows." Jorge thought about it for days. Then he remembered something. When he was eight, he broke their mother's favourite {{vase}} and was too scared to tell her. Álex, who was twelve, said that he had done it, and he was {{punished}} for a whole week. He never told anyone the truth.

On the day of the wedding, Jorge's hands were shaking so much that he could hardly hold his notes. He started badly. The microphone made a terrible noise, and he forgot the first sentence. Then he looked at his brother, took a deep breath and told the story of the vase. The room went quiet. When he finished, he said, "So, Marta, you're marrying the kindest person I know. And Mum, I'm sorry about the vase."

Everyone laughed, and his mother laughed hardest of all. Several people cried. Álex stood up and hugged him. Later, many guests told Jorge it was the best speech they had ever heard. He doesn't believe them. But he has noticed something strange: he is not so afraid of speaking in public any more. "The worst thing already happened," he says. "The microphone {{screamed}}, and I survived."

punished.meaning: made to suffer because you did something wrong

screamed.meaning: made a very loud high noise

best man.meaning: a man who helps the person getting married and often gives a speech

questions.question: Why did Jorge feel sick in the car?
options: He remembered that the best man has to give a speech.
His brother was angry with him.
He didn't want to go to the wedding.
questions.explanation: He remembered that the best man gives a speech in front of two hundred people.

questions.question: What was wrong with the third speech?
options: It was full of private jokes.
It was so serious that his girlfriend fell asleep.
It was about the wrong person.
questions.explanation: The third was so serious that his girlfriend fell asleep while he practised.

questions.question: What did Álex do when Jorge broke the vase?
options: He told their mother the truth.
He said that he had broken it himself and was punished.
questions.explanation: Álex said he had done it and was punished for a whole week.

questions.question: How has the speech changed Jorge?
options: He now gives speeches as a job.
He is less afraid of speaking in public.
He never wants to use a microphone again.
questions.explanation: He has noticed he is not so afraid of speaking in public any more.
